title: MineralExp: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Experimental Design in Real-World Mineral Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2611.17931v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In mineral exploration, verifying geological hypotheses relies on designing a variety of geochemical experiments. While large language model (LLM) agents increasingly automate downstream geoscientific data analysis, a crucial upstream capability remains largely unexplored: automated geochemical experimental design, i.e., deciding which experiments to conduct before committing to costly laboratory work. Evaluating this capability of LLM agents is difficult for two reasons. First, geochemical experiments exhibit high methodological diversity and subjectivity: to test the same hypothesis, different geologists may choose different minerals and instruments, so no single protocol can serve as the reference answer. Second, open-ended experimental plans resist representation as structured labels, which makes objective scoring difficult. translated_title: MineralExp：面向真实世界矿产勘探中实验设计的LLM智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 在矿产勘探中，验证地质假设依赖于设计多种地球化学实验。虽然大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益自动化地完成下游的地球科学数据分析任务，但一个关键的上游能力在很大程度上仍未被探索：自动化地球化学实验设计，即在开展昂贵的实验室工作之前决定应该进行哪些实验。评估LLM智能体的这一能力面临两大困难。首先，地球化学实验具有高度的方法多样性和主观性：为了检验同一假设，不同的地质学家可能会选择不同的矿物和仪器，因此没有单一的实验方案可以作为标准参考答案。其次，开放式的实验方案难以表示为结构化标签，这使得客观评分变得困难。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MineralExp，这是一个将地球化学实验设计进行重新表述的基准……
tldr: 提出首个面向真实矿产勘探场景的MineralExp基准，用于评估LLM智能体自动化地球化学实验设计的能力，并解决了实验方法多样性与主观性高、开放式方案难以客观评分两大难题。
en_tdlr: MineralExp is the first benchmark for evaluating LLM agents' automated geochemical experimental design in real-world mineral exploration, tackling the challenges of high methodological diversity/subjectivity and the difficulty of objectively scoring open-ended experimental plans.
